analyst.summary: Shree Renuka Sugars is a sugar, ethanol and power company majority-owned by global agribusiness group Wilmar, but its balance sheet is under real stress - the company has posted losses in most recent quarters, its net worth has turned negative, and its operating profit does not come close to covering interest costs. While India's ethanol-blending policy is a genuine long-term tailwind for distillery-linked sugar producers, it has not yet turned around this company's financial position. We view the shares as high-risk and would not hold them.
